name: New Brunswick Community College (NBCC)
desc: A two-year program covering the full software development lifecycle, from object-oriented design and MVC web applications to databases and cloud deployment.
highlights: Designed and built a roguelike game in C# and WPF as the final OOP project, applying inheritance, polymorphism and clean class architecture.

name: Self-Directed Learning
desc: Outside of class, I learn by building real things, usually in languages and tools the curriculum doesn't cover, to understand how they work under the hood.
highlights: Wrote a JSON parser from scratch in C++ to learn how tokenizing and parsing work.
Building a chess database in Rust with a Tauri desktop front end.
Maintain a custom Neovim configuration in Lua, tuned for my own workflow.
